Recents thumbnail hiding now implemented (setRecentsScreenshotEnabled on API 33+, FLAG_SECURE below); prior deferred finding resolved

setRecentsHidden is applied only when `enabled` changes; native returns false (swallowed) if currentActivity is null at cold start, and a new Activity instance (task relaunched while process/JS alive) loses the per-activity setting. Cheap fix: also re-apply in the existing AppState 'active' handler (void setRecentsHidden(useAppLockStore.getState().enabled)). Narrow window: hydrate awaits SecureStore so activity is almost always attached; configChanges prevents rotation recreation
